purpose: confirmation of the current probing claims and floor rules on proteins no part of this work has inspected, including cohort A's analysis

cohort.rule: in cath-dataset-nonredundant-S40-v4_4_0.list, absent from cath-domain-list-v4_3_0.txt, and not drawn into cohort A (confirmation/cohort_manifest.csv)
cohort.provenance: experimental structures, the CATH domain PDB set
cohort.not_claimed: absence from any encoder's pretraining corpus

floors.admissible: extract/encoder_atom_audit.csv and extract/encoder_input_audit.csv, released proteins only; multi-atom floors rebuilt on the encoder's atom set by scripts/atom_matched_floors.py

protocol.fit_on: probing_data/splits/superfamily_train.txt and superfamily_val.txt, v4.3, released embeddings
protocol.evaluate_on: the cohort B manifest written by this script, never used in fitting or selection
protocol.readouts: closed-form ridge with the penalty chosen on the released validation split, and MLP-2 (width 128, at most 30 epochs, patience 3, seeds 0/1/2); the family is chosen on validation loss
protocol.aggregation: mean over seeds within a readout family, then the better family, as in floor_vs_encoders.py
protocol.floor_assignment: the measured input audit in extract/encoder_input_audit.csv, unchanged
protocol.no_refitting: no descriptor, threshold, probe or readout rule may be changed after this file is written

hypotheses.claim: On the nine informative determined probes, every coordinate-reading encoder in the panel scores below the floor built from the atoms it receives.
hypotheses.decision: confirmed if both coordinate encoders fall below their floor on at least 7 of the 9 probes

hypotheses.claim: On the nine informative determined probes, no sequence-only encoder in the panel falls below the sequence floor.
hypotheses.decision: confirmed if 0 of the 27 sequence-only cells falls below the floor

hypotheses.claim: On RSA, RSA bins and B-factor, some encoder in the panel beats every floor.
hypotheses.decision: confirmed if the best panel encoder exceeds the best floor on all three

hypotheses.claim: On fold architecture, ESM-IF1, ESM3 and ProstT5 clear ref_pairhist and ESM2-650M does not. ProstT5 is outside this panel, so the prediction is tested for ESM-IF1 and ESM3.
hypotheses.released: +0.055, +0.056 and +0.048 clear; ESM2-650M at -0.004 does not
hypotheses.decision: confirmed if ESM-IF1 and ESM3 exceed ref_pairhist and ESM2-650M does not

hypotheses.claim: H1 with each encoder held only to floors built from inputs it is measured to read (the residue-identity audit and the atom-level audit), the floor descriptor and readout family chosen on the released validation split.
hypotheses.released: the counts of scripts/floor_rules.py under rule 'both', computed on released data only
hypotheses.decision: confirmed if every coordinate-reading panel encoder falls below its floor on at least 7 of the 9 probes

hypotheses.claim: H2 with the sequence floor chosen on the released validation split.
hypotheses.released: the counts of scripts/floor_rules.py under rule 'both'
hypotheses.decision: confirmed if 0 of the 27 sequence-only cells falls below the floor

hypotheses.claim: H1 to H4 hold on the topology-novel part of cohort B: domains whose CATH topology is absent from the released training and validation splits.
hypotheses.released: not tested on the released data; on cohort A the topology-novel part has 51 domains
hypotheses.decision: each of H1 to H4 decided on that part with its own rule, if the part holds at least 20 domains; otherwise reported as not testable
